rows.details: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT)
Registrar (1) and Finance Officer - Audit, Taxation & Financial Compliance (1)
Pay Level L-14 as per Government of India Pay Scales
15 years of relevant administrative or professional post-qualification experience

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale. At least 15 years of experience as an Assistant Professor in Academic Pay Level-11 and above OR 8 years of service in Academic Pay Level-12 and above (including Associate Professor) with educational administration experience; OR comparable experience in a research/higher education institution; OR 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years must be as Deputy Registrar or equivalent. Qualification in Management or Law. Experience in computerized administration, legal, financial, or establishment matters. Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). Valid ICAI membership with a minimum of 15 years of post-qualification experience (relaxation possible for exceptional candidates). Experience in finance, accounts, audit, taxation, or financial compliance. Strong working knowledge of Income Tax Act, GST laws, TDS/TCS provisions, statutory/internal audit, government accounting, financial statements, budget preparation, procurement rules, PFMS, and project accounting. Upper Age Limit: 57 years for both Registrar and Finance Officer posts as of the last date of application submission.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The posts carry Government of India Pay Scales at Pay Level L-14 along with allowances such as Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and Conveyance Allowance as per rules. Positions are covered under the National Pension System (NPS) and eligible for Medical, LTC, and Children Education Allowance as per Institute norms. Candidates selected via direct recruitment are placed on a probation period of one year from the date of joining.

content_sections.heading: The Role
content_sections.text: Custodian of records, common seal, and funds of the Institute. Secretary (Non-member) to the Board of Governors, Senate, Finance Committee, and Building & Works Committee. Supervision, recruitment, assessment, mentoring, and welfare of employees. Oversee statutory reporting, liaison with ministries, administration, official correspondence, purchases, accounts, establishment, and legal matters.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGIPT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.rgipt.ac.in and navigate to the recruitment page under the Non-teaching Staff link. Click on the "Apply Online" link for regular positions. Keep personal, qualification, experience details, and a soft copy of your passport-size photograph ready. Complete the online application form and pay the application fee of Rs. 1000.00 (General & OBC) or Rs. 500.00 (SC/ST/Female & Divyang) via net banking, debit, or credit card. Applicants serving in Government, Semi-Government, Central or State Autonomous Bodies must submit an NOC from their employer. Submit the online application on or before 31.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be assessed through a Presentation (50 marks, 10 minutes limit) followed by a Personal Interview (50 marks) conducted at RGIPT Jais Campus, Uttar Pradesh. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RGIPT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application fee for the General and OBC category?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates applying for Pay Level-14 posts is Rs. 1000.00.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for the Registrar and Finance Officer posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 57 years for both posts.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Applicants applying for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post along with a separate NOC, failing which the application will be considered only for the first post indicated.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: The selection process including the presentation and interview takes place at RGIPT Jais Campus, Uttar Pradesh only.
